purpose: Define the observation-level master cohort for Chapter 1 v3 ecological inference without reading capitulum measurements or environmental outcomes.

sampling_rules.reason: The 60-row taxon cap used for environment-only collinearity diagnostics is not inherited by ecological inference. Dominance is handled in the hierarchical model rather than by deleting observations.

measurement_scheduling.eligible_source_linked_photos: schedule every recoverable source-linked photo for a master-cohort observation when the source license permits image retrieval and an original-size URL can be constructed
measurement_scheduling.storage: stream/process/discard; source image bytes are not retained as the analysis archive
measurement_scheduling.photo_weighting: multiple eligible photos remain nested within observation and do not receive independent observation weight
measurement_scheduling.head_weighting: multiple detected heads remain nested within photo and do not receive independent observation weight
measurement_scheduling.failure_states: download failure, no detection, no endpoint-eligible head, license-unavailable and unresolved image version remain explicit states rather than zero-valued phenotypes

post_measurement_support_rules_fixed_bef.global_hierarchical_fit: retain all master-cohort observations with a QC-qualified endpoint and finite frozen environmental exposure; taxa are partially pooled and photograph abundance is not a taxon weight

taxon_specific_slope_reporting.environment_requirement: the frozen exposure must have more than one finite value within the taxon; report actual within-taxon exposure span and uncertainty rather than selecting a favourable span cutoff
taxon_specific_slope_reporting.effect_of_failure: taxon remains in coverage and pooled hierarchy but its individual slope is not interpreted as a supported taxon-level estimate

among_taxon_summary_reporting.effect_of_failure: retain in coverage ledger but do not present the taxon mean as a primary among-taxon point estimate

spatial_design.support_cell_definition: floor(latitude*4)/4 by floor(longitude*4)/4, used only for descriptive support accounting and taxon-specific slope reporting eligibility
spatial_design.note: Spatial structure belongs in the primary model. Quarter-degree support cells are not treated as independent biological replicates or a substitute for the spatial model.

claim_ceiling: This cohort defines source support for spatial association. It does not validate image identification, physical trait accuracy, adaptation or mechanism.
